# dsh-jipu
Jipu (计谱) manuscript crew for DeepSeek Harness — a reader-first, gate-driven pipeline for long-form
fiction, packaged as a DSH host plugin.
## What it gives you
A single `jipu` tool with four actions:
| action | does |
| `skill` | read the manuscript manual (`SKILL.md`) and its 12 references, paginated with `offset` /

`limit` |
| `scripts` | list the 14 gate scripts |
| `run` | run a gate script inside a project roo

t (requires `project`) |
| `selftest` | run a script's built-in `--selftest` |
The 14 scripts cover: project scaffold, option-card check, capability self-test, recall pack, senten
ce check, object inventory, dialogue attribution, image/filter check, chapter metrics, number ledger
, chapter physical, chapter gate, reader verdict, ledger check.
The skill ships the full manuscript workflow: outline-first chapter construction, eight-beat outline
, three hard gates, T0/T1/T2 delivery tiers, three revision loops, plus 12 genre template libraries,
81 beat templates and a trope library.

lf-test and for opening a new project. Judge a manuscript with the project's own copy, not this one.
